privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy covers the IHF Rules Quiz website, progressive web app, and Android and iOS apps. Kristof Gilis operates the app. For privacy questions or requests, email
privacy.device: The app saves your language, theme, and display preferences, along with downloaded rules, questions, answers, scoring configuration, and sync information. Quiz answers are held in the app while you take a quiz.
privacy.online_label: When the website or an earlier store build connects:
privacy.online: The app sends requests to load content and search results. These requests may include your selected language and search text. For online scoring, it sends question IDs and selected answer IDs to the API to calculate a result.
privacy.technical: The web and API hosting services may process information needed to deliver and protect the service, such as an IP address, request time, requested page or endpoint, response status, and browser or device information.
privacy.contact: We receive the email address and information you include in your message so we can reply.
privacy.no_account: The app does not require an account. It does not use advertising, analytics, or a separate crash reporting service. The API does not maintain a personal quiz history.
privacy.purpose: We use it to provide the quiz and rules content, remember your choices, make downloaded content available offline, calculate scores, respond to messages, and keep the service working and secure. For personal data processed by the online service, we rely on our legitimate interests in providing and securing these functions. You can object to processing based on legitimate interests by contacting us.
privacy.offline: The website and earlier store builds need an initial content download for offline use. The rebuilt native apps include their content and work offline immediately.
privacy.hosting_before_link: Microsoft Azure hosts the website and API and processes service requests on our behalf. We do not sell your information or share it with advertising or analytics providers. Microsoft may process service data in other countries under the safeguards described in its
privacy.hosting_after_link: Contact us for details about transfers relevant to this service.
privacy.retention_local: Website preferences and downloaded content remain until site data is cleared or evicted. Earlier store builds may retain their downloaded cache until app data is removed. The rebuilt native apps keep preferences and saved quiz state locally until they are replaced or removed as described above. We do not keep a server-side quiz history.
privacy.retention_logs: As checked on 24 October 2026, application and HTTP request logging are disabled for the website and API in Azure App Service, and neither app sends diagnostic logs to Azure Monitor. Because those logs are off, we do not retain request logs through these settings. Azure may still process technical data to provide and protect its hosting service. If we enable logging, we will update this policy with the retention period. You can ask us to delete personal data we hold. We keep contact messages only as long as needed to handle the request and any related obligations.
privacy.choices: You can change language and appearance in Settings. Clear site storage to remove website data; delete the app or clear its storage to remove native app data. The native quiz, privacy policy and support pages work offline. Sending support email needs a connection.
privacy.rights_before_email: Depending on applicable law, you may ask to access, correct, delete, or restrict your personal data, object to its processing, or request a portable copy. Email
privacy.rights_after_email: to make a request. You may also complain to your local data protection authority.
privacy.changes: We may update this policy when the app or its data practices change. The updated date at the top shows when this page was last revised.
privacy.native_details: The SwiftUI iOS app includes its content and works offline from the first launch. Rules, questions, search and scoring run on the device. Language, appearance and quiz state are stored locally; answers and results are not sent to our API. Normal use makes no network requests. The privacy policy and support pages are included in the app. Choosing to email support opens your email service and requires connectivity. App stores deliver app and content updates. Device backups may include local preferences and quiz state. Delete the app or clear its storage to remove local native data. A saved quiz remains until you discard or replace it, its content version changes, or app data is removed.
